appTagline: Learn the rules of Quran recitation, one short step at a time.
heroSubtitle: A short, mobile-first course on the rules of Tilawat — written for absolute beginners and rendered in English, বাংলা, and العربية.
sampleAyahTranslation: So when you recite the Qur'an, seek refuge with Allah from Satan, the expelled.
chooseSub: Tap any card to enter the reader. Each module is broken into slides; you can only advance once you've checked off the current step.
cardTapHint: Begin · Tap anywhere on this card
stepOneTitle: Read one slide at a time
stepOneBody: Each slide covers one rule with a short checklist. You won't see the next one until the current is acknowledged.
stepTwoBody: Where relevant, the slide cites the Qur'an itself — Arabic original, with translation in your chosen language.
stepThreeBody: Want more than a beginner sketch? Some slides link to a longer blog article you can read whenever you like.
footerNote: Built static · No tracking · No account needed
